completed.title: One-minute website cache
changes: Public website files use a 60-second browser cache with versioned ETags; unchanged files revalidate without another download.
Decoded assets are reused in a bounded 16 MiB Worker cache for one minute, reducing repeated base64 decoding.

Public universe statistics, the staff directory and paged world surveys use a one-minute response cache, including simultaneous-request coalescing. Successful writes invalidate Worker public-data caches.
Protected HTML, personal profiles, game mutations and staff APIs retain live authorisation and no-store responses.

completed.title: Configurable staff permission nodes
changes: Support and Multihunter permission matrices on Account ranks; immutable Administrator grants; audited saves with revision checks.
Menus and API routes use the same fresh permissions, without needing a planet. Only Administrators can grant Administrator rank or edit the matrix.

completed.title: Network Hub fleet spacing
changes: Separate fleet panels and intel controls receive consistent theme-independent spacing, wrapped controls and horizontal table scrolling.
